visualCharacteristics: Non-looping hero slider of 2:3 to 2:1 image banners with parallax and dark gradient, copy overlaid on the grid, slide counter and round outline arrow buttons.
contentPattern: One row per card: picture (optional second picture = mobile crop), category paragraph before the heading, h3 with the card link, abstract paragraph(s).
usage: Use to feature a rotating set of large news or event banners that link to their articles.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any featured news/events slider by authoring one row per card with image, category, linked title and abstract.
